answer: Mechanism: Cadence admission gate. New identities submit timestamped requests over a fixed window; admission requires inter-arrival variance and autocorrelation inside a calibrated band, rejecting metronomic bots and bursty floods. An attacker must run a separate scheduler per identity and spread decoy traffic, paying wall-clock delay and bandwidth per identity. River-like bursts are throttled. Steady knoll-like clusters are rechecked. Ocean-scale farming multiplies these delays by identity count.
